steps.title: Dashboard loads with ready status
steps.narration: The app boots and shows the main dashboard. The top-right badge displays a green Ready indicator, confirming the backend is available and listening.
steps.point_out: The badge in the top-right reads 'Ready' with a green dot; the dashboard is fully rendered.

steps.title: Data page opens with the backfill job panel
steps.narration: Navigate to the Data section, where operators can start fetch and backfill jobs. The form shows date-range inputs and a job-kind dropdown.
steps.point_out: The 'Start a fetch / backfill job' panel is visible with Start date and End date fields; the Job kind dropdown reads 'Backfill snapshots'.

steps.title: Submit a backfill job for May 2026
steps.narration: Fill in the date range from May 2 to May 29, 2026, and start the job. The system will backfill historical snapshots for those trading days.
steps.point_out: After clicking Start, the Job progress panel shows the job moving toward completion; the summary will report how many trading days were processed.

steps.title: Backfill job finishes and reports results
steps.narration: The job completes and shows its final status. If this is a fresh range, it will report 19 trading days snapshotted. If the range was already backfilled, a distinct 'no new snapshots' badge explains the zero-work run.
steps.point_out: The Job progress panel shows a terminal status (not 'running'); the summary mentions either '19' trading days or a 'no new snapshots' badge.

steps.title: Click Start to launch the backfill
steps.narration: The Start button submits the backfill request. Watch the Job progress panel update as the system processes the date range.
steps.point_out: The Job progress panel becomes active and shows the job running; then it moves to a finished state.

steps.title: Scanner Runs detail page shows the stored leaderboard
steps.narration: Navigate to Scanner Runs and open the row for May 29, 2026. The page loads the immutable leaderboard that was computed and stored during the backfill.
steps.point_out: A populated leaderboard table is visible with stock symbols and rankings; never an empty 'No stored stock rows' message.

steps.title: Backtest page loads evidence from storage, never recomputing
steps.narration: Open the Backtest page, which displays precomputed evidence. If a background aggregation is in flight, an honest 'Refreshing' banner appears. Once complete, the banner disappears and fresh values display.
steps.point_out: The evidence panel loads with either normal values or a 'Refreshing — showing the last complete evidence' banner; the page never shows a blank or spinning state.

steps.title: Ready badge discloses background compute in flight
steps.narration: If a background aggregation is still running, the top-right badge shows 'Ready' plus an extra chip reading 'background compute running (N)', disclosing the in-flight compute. Once complete, the chip disappears.
steps.point_out: The top-right badge either shows just 'Ready' (if no compute is in flight), or 'Ready' with an additional 'background compute running' chip showing the count.
